quoted_text: Oracle's FY26 datasheet (October 2026) reports Scope 2 location-based emissions of 2,690,440 tCO2e and market-based emissions of 4,299 tCO2e ... No assurance statement naming a provider or level was found.

CONTRIBUTING: a company figure is a record only when an auditor's assurance covers it; the entry itself says none was found. measurements.csv already carries all four Scope 2 values as side=claim, basis company_statement, so the ledger page and the table disagree.
suggested_fix: Move the Oracle figures to claim; record = 'no assured or regulator figure found'.

quoted_text: A CREA/Global Energy Monitor report (27 Jan 2026) records 19.3 GW ... Climate Rights International ('Nickel Unearthed', Jan 2024) ... records at least 5,331 ha ... Mongabay's report on the study cites 1,456 ha (confidence high, verified)

CREA/GEM and Climate Rights International are NGOs and Mongabay/Eco-Business are press, yet they sit in record with confidence high and status verified. The measurements table has 8 rows for this entry with side=record and basis ngo_report/press_report.
suggested_fix: Keep USGS in record; move NGO/press figures out of record (or label as secondary) and lower confidence.

quoted_text: A Toxics Link study (2019; reported 17 October 2019) identified 15 informal e-waste processing hotspots ... Delhi-NCR generation was cited at 85,000 t (Assocham, as quoted by Down To Earth) (confidence high, verified)

suggested_fix: Record: 'no CPCB/DPCC record found'; move Toxics Link findings to a labelled secondary note; confidence low.

quoted_text: BAN's 'Scam Recycling' (15 Sep 2016) recorded 69 of 205 US-deployed GPS trackers (34%) exported ... BAN's 'Brokers of Shame' (22 Oct 2025) extrapolates ... to an estimated 395,352 t/yr

The operator field lists Basel Action Network next to the Basel Secretariat as if it were a responsible party.
suggested_fix: Keep the Basel decision in record; move BAN figures out of record; drop BAN from operator.

quoted_text: Global Witness (23 May 2024) records more than 300 mining sites ... and Chinese import data of 41,700 t of heavy rare-earth oxides from Myanmar in 2023 (US$1.4 bn)

suggested_fix: Basis ngo_report until Chinese customs data are read; move Global Witness figures out of record.

quoted_text: Company statements: Microsoft's 'Updating our Carbon Removal Portfolio' (January 2026) lists contracts 'totaling more than 78 million metric tonnes' ... Frontier's progress page ... lists 1,835,427 tons contracted

quoted_text: Isometric: Vaulted Deep selected Isometric as registry for its Microsoft offtake of 'up to 4.9 million tonnes of carbon removal through to 2038' (17 July 2025).

quoted_text: value_as_published '345-MW', '2.8 GW', '6.6 GW' (TerraPower); '320 MW', '960 MW' (Cascade); 'up to 50 MW' (Kairos-TVA); '1.2 GW' (Oklo Pike County): side=record, basis press_report
